reason: I'd try the free tricks right after the Reel, and if the gallery or the search reveal fools my wife, I'd pay the 99 ₪ that same night. For a hobby magician this is exactly the kind of thing I already buy, and in Hebrew it plays better for my friends.
objection: I'll use it twice and get bored, and an app installed from the browser instead of the App Store makes me worry it stops working after the next phone update.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks look obviously fake or the reveal is clunky in front of people, I'd close it and not pay.
